content.short: Base Paint is a collaborative pixel-art platform on Base where artists create collective daily NFT masterpieces.
content.description:
Base Paint is a unique collaborative pixel-art decentralized application native to the Base network. Every day, a new digital canvas is opened for 24 hours, allowing artists and users from around the world to contribute by painting individual pixels on a shared grid. This collective process transforms the canvas into a community-driven artwork that captures the spirit of the day. At the end of each period, the final masterpiece is minted as an open-edition NFT, immortalizing the collaboration on the blockchain.

The proceeds from these daily NFT mints are shared among the contributing artists, providing a novel way for creators to earn rewards for their participation. By blending social interaction with on-chain creativity, Base Paint has become a vibrant hub for the digital art community on the Base network. It showcases the power of collective expression and decentralized ownership, offering a fun and engaging way for users to participate in the NFT ecosystem.
